record.paper_title: Regularity of maximal operators: recent progress and some open problems
record.original_question: Let M be the one-dimensional centered Hardy-Littlewood maximal operator. Let BV(R) be the Banach space of real-valued functions on R of bounded total variation with norm ||f||_{BV(R)} = |f(-infinity)| + Var(f), where f(-infinity) is the limit of f(x) as x tends to -infinity. Is the map M: BV(R) -> BV(R) continuous?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ denote the one-dimensional centered Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator, defined for locally integrable $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ by
$$Mf(x) = \sup_{r>0} \frac{1}{2r}\int_{x-r}^{x+r} |f(t)|\,dt.$$
Let $\mathrm{BV}(\mathbb{R})$ denote the Banach space of real-valued functions on $\mathbb{R}$ of bounded total variation, equipped with the norm
$$\|f\|_{\mathrm{BV}(\mathbb{R})} = |f(-\infty)| + \operatorname{Var}(f),$$
where $f(-\infty) = \lim_{x\to -\infty} f(x)$ and $\operatorname{Var}(f)$ denotes the total variation of $f$ on $\mathbb{R}$.

Determine whether the map $M:\mathrm{BV}(\mathbb{R})\to\mathrm{BV}(\mathbb{R})$ is continuous.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Gonzalez-Riquelme–Madrid, arXiv:2109.09691, J. Funct. Anal. 2023) established continuity of the map $f\mapsto (Mf)'$ from $W^{1,1}(\mathbb{R})$ to $L^1(\mathbb{R})$ for the one-dimensional centered Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator, and BV continuity has been resolved for the uncentered analog. However, the continuity of $M:\mathrm{BV}(\mathbb{R})\to\mathrm{BV}(\mathbb{R})$ in the centered case appears to remain open as of these works.

status_evidence.title: Continuity for the one-dimensional centered Hardy-Littlewood maximal operator at the derivative level
status_evidence.snippet: We prove continuity of f↦(Mf)' from W^{1,1}(R) to L^1(R) for the centered Hardy-Littlewood maximal operator, leaving BV continuity as an open question.
status_evidence.claim: Derivative-level W^{1,1} continuity established; BV continuity for the centered operator not addressed/remains open.

status_evidence.title: BV continuity for the uncentered Hardy–Littlewood maximal operator
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes BV continuity for the uncentered one-dimensional maximal operator.
status_evidence.claim: Resolves the uncentered analog, leaving the centered BV continuity question as a remaining open problem.
